void.string: Average height of waves (highest 1/3rd) on the water column
The average peak to trough height of the highest 1/3 of waves measured during a recording burst
Average zero crossing period (highest one third) of waves on the water column
The average period of the highest 1/3 of waves measured during a recording burst
Concentration of 1,1,2-trichloro-1,2,2-trifluoroethane {freon-113 or CFC-113} per unit mass of the water column [dissolved phase]
Concentration (moles or mass) of 1,1,2-trichloro-1,2,2-trifluoroethane {freon-113 or CFC-113} per unit mass of the water column.
Concentration of alloxanthin per unit volume of the water column
Mass of the carotenoid pigment alloxanthin per unit volume of a water body. The pigment is contained in suspended particles of unspecified size.
Concentration of aluminium {Al} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental aluminium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of aluminium {Al} per unit dry weight of suspended particulate material
Mass of elemental aluminium per unit mass of solid material suspended in the water column
Concentration of amino acids per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of all amino acids (organic compounds containing at least one amine group plus at least one carboxyllic acid group) per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of ammonium {NH4} per unit mass of the water column [dissolved phase]
Concentration (moles or mass) of nitrogen as ammonium per unit mass of the water column.
Concentration of ammonium {NH4} per unit volume of the water column [unknown phase]
Concentration of ammonium per unit volume of the water column. Ammonium may be expressed in terms of mass or quantity of substance.
Concentration of barium {Ba} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental barium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of barium {Ba} per unit dry weight of suspended particulate material
Mass of elemental barium per unit mass of solid material suspended in the water column
Concentration of bases per unit mass of the water column [dissolved phase]
Concentration (moles or mass) of acid-neutralising bases per unit mass of the water column.
Concentration of bromine {Br} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental bromine per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of calcium {Ca} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental calcium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of calcium {Ca} per unit dry weight of suspended particulate material
Mass of elemental calcium per unit mass of solid material suspended in the water column
Concentration of carbon (organic) per unit dry weight of sediment
Concentration (moles or mass) of organic carbon (not carbonates) per unit mass of bed sediment
Concentration of carbon (organic) per unit volume of the water column [particulate phase]
Concentration (moles or mass) of organic carbon (i.e. carbon not in carbonate or bicarbonate molecules) in suspended particulate material per unit volume of the water column
Concentration of carbon (total inorganic) {TCO2} per unit volume of the water column [dissolved plus reactive particulate phase]
Concentration of dissolved inorganic carbon per unit volume of the water column. Solute may be expressed in terms of mass or quantity of substance.
Concentration of carbon (total) per unit dry weight of sediment
Concentration (moles or mass) of total carbon (carbon in any chemical form) per unit mass of bed sediment
Concentration of carbon (total) per unit volume of the water column [particulate phase]
Concentration (moles or mass) of total carbon (i.e. carbon in any chemical form) in suspended particulate material per unit volume of the water column
Concentration of carbonate {CO3} per unit dry weight of sediment
The mass of carbonate (CO3) per unit mass of bed sediment
Concentration of cerium {Ce} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental cerium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of chlorine {Cl} per unit dry weight of suspended particulate material
Mass of elemental chlorine per unit mass of solid material suspended in the water column
Concentration of chlorophyll-a per unit volume of the water column

The mass of all variants of chlorophyll-a per unit volume of the water column held in particles of any size. Includes measurements made by instruments unable to resolve chorophyll-a types and the sum of HPLC chlorophyll-a types.
Concentration of chlorophyll-b per unit volume of the water column
Mass of all forms of the pigment chlorophyll-b per unit volume of a water body. The pigment is contained in suspended particles of unspecified size.
Concentration of chlorophyll-c per unit volume of the water column
Mass of all forms of the pigment chlorophyll-c3 per unit volume of a water body. The pigment is contained in suspended particles of unspecified size.
Concentration of chlorophyll-c1c2 per unit volume of the water column
Combined mass of the pigments chlorophyll-c1 and chlorophyll-c2 per unit volume of a water body. The pigment is contained in suspended particles of unspecified size.
Concentration of chlorophyll-c3 per unit volume of the water column
Mass of all forms of the the pigment chlorophyll-c3 per unit volume of a water body. The pigment is contained in suspended particles of unspecified size.
Concentration of chromium {Cr} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental chromium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of copper {Cu} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental copper per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of dichlorodifluoromethane {freon-12 or CFC-12} per unit mass of the water column [dissolved phase]
Concentration (moles or mass) of dichlorodifluoromethane {freon-12 or CFC-12} per unit mass of the water column.
Concentration of fucoxanthin per unit volume of the water column
Mass of the carotenoid pigment fucoxanthin per unit volume of a water body. The pigment is contained in suspended particles of unspecified size.
Concentration of hydrogen sulphide {H2S} per unit volume of the water column [dissolved plus reactive particulate phase]
Concentration of dissolved hydrogen sulphide per unit volume of the water column. Hydrogen sulphide may be expressed in terms of mass, volume or quantity of substance.
Concentration of iodine {I} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental iodine per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of iron (total) {Fe} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental iron per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of iron (total) {Fe} per unit dry weight of suspended particulate material
Mass of elemental iron per unit mass of solid material suspended in the water column
Concentration of lanthanum {La} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental lanthanum per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of lead {Pb} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental lead per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of magnesium {Mg} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental magnesium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of magnesium {Mg} per unit dry weight of suspended particulate material
Mass of elemental magnesium per unit mass of solid material suspended in the water column
Concentration of manganese {Mn} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental manganese per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of manganese {Mn} per unit dry weight of suspended particulate material
Mass of elemental manganese per unit mass of solid material suspended in the water column
Concentration of mercury {Hg} per unit dry weight of suspended particulate material
Mass of elemental mercury per unit mass of solid material suspended in the water column
Concentration of molybdenum {Mo} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental zirconium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of neodynium {Nd} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental neodynium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of nickel {Ni} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental nickel per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of niobium {Nb} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental niobium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of nitrate {NO3} per unit mass of the water column [dissolved phase]
Concentration (moles or mass) of nitrogen as nitrate per unit mass of the water column.
Concentration of nitrate {NO3} per unit volume of the water column [unknown phase]
Concentration of nitrate per unit volume of the water column. Nitrate may be expressed in terms of mass or quantity of substance.
Concentration of nitrate+nitrite {NO3+NO2} per unit mass of the water column [dissolved phase]
Concentration (moles or mass) of nitrogen as nitrate+nitrite per unit mass of the water column.
Concentration of nitrate+nitrite {NO3+NO2} per unit volume of the water column [unknown phase]
Concentration of nitrate+nitrite per unit volume of the water column. Nitrate+nitrite may be expressed in terms of mass or quantity of substance.
Concentration of nitrite per unit volume of the water column [unknown phase]
Concentration of nitrite per unit volume of the water column. Nitrite may be expressed in terms of mass or quantity of substance.
Concentration of nitrite {NO2} per unit mass of the water column [dissolved phase]
Concentration (moles or mass) of nitrogen as nitrite per unit mass of the water column.
Concentration of nitrogen (organic) per unit mass of the water column [dissolved phase]
Concentration (moles or mass) of nitrogen in molecules containing carbon per unit mass of the water column.
Concentration of nitrogen (organic) per unit volume of the water column [dissolved phase]
Concentration (moles or mass) of nitrogen in molecules containing carbon per unit volume of the water column.
Concentration of nitrogen (total) per unit volume of the water column [dissolved plus reactive particulate phase]

Concentration of nitrogen in all species other than dissolved gaseous nitrogen per unit volume of the water column held both in solution and in partciles of any size. Nitrogen may be expressed in terms of mass or quantity of substance.
Concentration of nitrogen (total) per unit volume of the water column [particulate phase]
Concentration (moles or mass) of total nitrogen (i.e. nitrogen in all chemical forms) in suspended particulate material per unit volume of the water column.
Concentration of oxygen {O2} per unit mass of the water column [dissolved phase]
Concentration of dissolved oxygen per unit mass of the water column. Oxygen may be expressed in terms of mass, volume or quantity of substance.
Concentration of oxygen {O2} per unit volume of the water column [dissolved phase]
Concentration of dissolved oxygen per unit volume of the water column. Oxygen may be expressed in terms of mass, volume or quantity of substance.
Concentration of phosphate {PO4} per unit volume of the water column [unknown phase]
Concentration of phosphate per unit volume of the water column. Phosphate may be expressed in terms of mass or quantity of substance.
Concentration of phosphorus (total) per unit volume of the water column [dissolved plus reactive particulate phase]

Concentration of phosphorus in all species per unit volume of the water column held both in solution and in partciles of any size. Phosphorous may be expressed in terms of mass or quantity of substance.
Concentration of phosphorus {P} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental phosphorus per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of phosphorus {P} per unit dry weight of suspended particulate material
Mass of elemental phosphorus per unit mass of solid material suspended in the water column
Concentration of potassium {K} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental potassium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of potassium {K} per unit dry weight of suspended particulate material
Mass of elemental potassium per unit mass of solid material suspended in the water column
Concentration of rubidium {Rb} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental rubidium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of scandium {Sc} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental scandium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of silicate {SiO4} per unit mass of the water column [dissolved phase]
Concentration (moles or mass) of silicon as silicate per unit mass of the water column.
Concentration of silicate {SiO4} per unit volume of the water column [unknown phase]
Concentration of silicate per unit volume of the water column. Silicate may be expressed in terms of mass or quantity of substance.
Concentration of silicon {Si} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental silicon per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of silicon {Si} per unit dry weight of suspended particulate material
Mass of elemental silicon per unit mass of solid material suspended in the water column
Concentration of sodium {Na} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental sodium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of strontium {Sr} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental strontium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of sulphur {S} per unit dry weight of suspended particulate material
Mass of elemental sulphur per unit mass of solid material suspended in the water column
Concentration of thorium {Th} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental thorium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of titanium {Ti} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental titanium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of titanium {Ti} per unit dry weight of suspended particulate material
Mass of elemental titanium per unit mass of solid material suspended in the water column
Concentration of trichlorofluoromethane {freon-11 or CFC-11} per unit mass of the water column [dissolved phase]
Concentration (moles or mass) of trichlorofluoromethane {freon-11 or CFC-11} per unit mass of the water column.
Concentration of uranium {U} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental uranium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of vanadium {V} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental vanadium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of yttrium {Y} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental yttrium per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of zinc {Zn} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental zinc per unit mass of dry sediment
Concentration of zirconium {Zr} per unit dry weight of sediment
Mass of elemental molybdenum per unit mass of dry sediment
Current direction in the water column
The direction towards which Eulerian current in the water column is flowing.
Current speed in the water column
The speed of Eulerian flow in the water column.
Depth below surface of the bed
The distance of a sensor or sampling point below the floor of a water body
Depth below surface of the water column
The distance of a sensor or sampling point below the sea surface
Dew point temperature of the atmosphere
The temperature to which air must cool to become saturated with water vapour
Eastward current velocity in the water column
Speed of Eulerian current flow towards due east.
Eastward wind velocity in the atmosphere
Wind velocity blowing towards due east
Maximum height of waves on the water column
The maximum vertical distance between a wave crest and the immediately preceding or following trough during a specified obervation period.
Maximum level of waves on the water column
The maximum zero crossing crest amplitude observed in a record.
Maximum zero crossing height of waves on the water column
The largest peak to trough height determined by zero crossing analysis of the demeaned wave elevation recording burst
Northward current velocity in the water column
Speed of Eulerian current flow towards true north.
Northward wind velocity in the atmosphere
Wind velocity blowing towards true north
Period at spectral maximum of waves on the water column
The period with the maximum wave energy, determined from the wave spectrum.
Practical salinity of the water column
The quantity of dissolved ions (predominantly salt in seawater) expressed on a scale (PSS-78) based on the conductivity ratio of a seawater sample to a standard KCl solution.
Pressure (measured variable) exerted by the water column by fixed in-situ pressure sensor and corrected to read zero at sea level
The force per unit area exerted by the water column on a fixed sensor located in the water column.
Pressure (spatial co-ordinate) exerted by the water column by profiling pressure sensor and corrected to read zero at sea level
The force per unit area exerted by the water column on a mobile sensor located in the water column.
The ratio of the amount of water vapour in the air compared to the maximum amount of water vapour that can theoretically be held at the air's temperature
Sea-floor depth (below instantaneous sea level) {bathymetric depth} in the water column
The distance between sea surface and sea bed measured from the sea surface at a particular instant in space and time.
Surface elevation (unspecified datum) of the water column
The elevation of the sea surface realtive to a known but unspecified datum.
The degree of hotness of the atmosphere expressed against a standard scale. Includes both IPTS-68 and ITS-90 scales.
The degree of hotness of the water column expressed against a standard scale. Includes both IPTS-68 and ITS-90 scales.
Total alkalinity of the water column
Concentration of acid-neutralising bases per unit volume of the water column. Solute may be expressed in terms of mass or quantity of substance.
Wind from direction in the atmosphere
Direction relative to true north from which the wind is blowing

Maximum speed of the wind (distance moved per unit time by a parcel of air) parallel to the ground during a gust event (generally regarded as an increase over sustained speed of more than 5 m/s lasting less than 20 seconds).
Sustained speed of the wind (distance moved per unit time by a parcel of air) parallel to the ground at a given place and time.
Minus the log of the hydrogen ion concentration (moles per litre) in the water column.
